1. Scope - Covers the essential dimensional, functional and quality characteristics of vernier callipers with least count 0'1 mm with measuring range above 1 000 mm up to and including 4 000 mm. I 8. General 8.1 Beam 8.1.1 The beam shall be long enough for the sliding jaw assembly not to overhang when measuring at the maximum measuring range and beam shall be relieved for sizes above 2000 mm to reduce the weight and friction. Requirements

8.2 Jaws 8.2.1 The projection J of the two jaws shall be equal. The minimum projection of the jaws J shall be as given in Table 1. The maximum projection of the jaws J shall not exceed 200 mm. 8.2.2 The sliding jdw shall be a good sliding fit along the beam in order to permit fine adjustments to be made. The sliding jaw shall be provided with a suitable clamp so that it may be effectively clamped to the beam. 8.2.3 The minimum length of the faces for external projection of the jaws. 8.2.4 measurement, La Min shall be one-half the

The minimum length of internal measuring jaws LX shall be as given in Table 1.

8.2.5 The nominal combined width Lc of the jaws for internal measurement shall be 20 or 40 mm to engrave the combined width of jaws on the face of the jaws when the jaws are closed. The faces for internal measurements shall be of cylindrical form with a radius not exceeding one-half of their combined width. 8.2.6 The fit of the sliding jaw on the beam shall permit the various accuracy to be complied with under all conditions of normal use. a.3 Scales 8.3.1 The beam shall be graduated in millimetres and figured in millimetres or centimetres. The length of the scale shall be at least equal to the measuring range of the callipers plus the length of the vernier scale. 8.3.2 The length of the vernier scale shall be 9 mm ( see Fig. 2 ).

8.3.3

The beam scale ( main scale ) of vernier calliper shall be graduated at 1 mm intervals.

8.3.4 The scale lines of both the beam and the vernier shall be straight, sharp edged and perpendicular to the edge of the beam, and their thickness shall be between 0'1 and 0'2 mm.

9.2 Measuring Faces - With the slider clamped to the beam at any position within the measuring range of the calliper, the faces for external measurement shall be flat to within 10 pm per 100 mm over their length. They shall be parallel to within 20 pm per 100 mm over their length.

9.2.1 The faces for internal measurement shall be parallel to within 10 pm over their length permissible tolerance for their combined width ( see 8.2.5) shall be +i" pm. and the

9.3 Scale Lines - In any one instrument, the thickness of all scale lines on the main scale and vernier shall not differ by more than 0'03 mm. - The vernier 10. Designation and number of this standard. Example: A vernier calliper with nominal size 2 000 mm and made of stainless steel shall be designated as: Vernier Calliper 2 000 Stainless Steel IS : 3651 ( Part 3 ) calliper shall be designated by the nominal size, the material used

11. Marking - Each vernier shall have legibly and permanently marked upon it, in characters not less than 2 mm high, the nominal size of the calliper, manufacturer's name or trade-mark, if any, and the unit symbol of the scale figured on the beam ( millimetres or centimetres). 11.1 Certification Marking Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards.

12. Packing - Each vernier shall be coated with suitable anticorrosive coating, and shall be wrapped Each vernier calliper shall -be packed in a moisture proof paper or any other suitable wrapping material. in a protective wooden case which will also be useful for storage after use.

(Clause METHOD 1)

A

OF TESTING

A-l. Measuring Uncertainty - The inherent errors of measurement of a vernier calliper may be checked with gauge block combinations of known size chosen to cover a number of points both over Checking may also be done by a standard measuring rod/ the range of instrument and that of vernier. length measuring machine of suitable range. A-l.1 The measuring faces of the gauge blocks shall be placed measuring faces of the calliper shall be checked at three points. A-2. Measuring Faces may be checked by applying a between the jaws and the outside

A-2.1 Flatness - The flatness of the faces for external measurements knife edge, straight edge or by another appropriate method.

A-2.2 Para//e/ism - The parallelism of the faces for external measurements may be checked by inserting gauge blocks between them at different points of the jaws and at different measured lengths by varying the sizes of the gauge blocks. Checking may also be done by a standard measuring rod/length measuring machine of suitable range. A-2.2.1 The parallelism of the faces for external measurements shall not be affected by clamping This may be checked by leaving a narrow gap between the measuring faces and observing slider. gap when clamping the slider. the this

A-2.2.2 The parallelism of the faces for internal measurements may be checked by means of a micrometer. To ensure that the radius is not too large, the combined jaws may be checked with a plain ring gauge of 20 or 40 mm diameter as applicable.
